answer: Proof of Personhood protocols utilize cryptographic attestations to ensure one identity per biological entity. Within the digital grove of an agent economy, nodes require a unique biometric signature to participate, effectively pruning the meadow of unverified bots. By forcing attackers to acquire scarce physical hardware or identity tokens, the willow of network security remains flexible yet resilient against mass identity spoofing, as the cost of generating new identities scales linearly with real-world effort.
